column1: # comment: "Model-serving alignments (extensions/model-serving slice). FLAGSHIP 1 \u2014 OpenTelemetry-GenAI (the occurrent shadow, INHABITED-ALIGNMENT.md): the OTel GenAI semantic conventions (the experimental gen_ai.* namespace) describe spans for model calls, tool calls, and agent operations \u2014 the runtime/invocation layer FAITHFULLY, and NOTHING of the durable subject, the tenure, continuity, or claims-as-observations. WHAT THIS FILE ACTUALLY EMITS: SSSOM gmeow:TermEquivalence term\u2194term rows at concept grain (below), pointing at the dereferenceable OTel-GenAI semconv registry concepts. That is the projected grain the SSSOM path emits, and it is the honest grain for these targets: the OTel gen_ai.* targets are span attribute KEYS with no RDF vocabulary, so a lawful logic:Correspondence lens \u2014 which operates over RDF path semantics \u2014 has no RDF view to project into, and the term row pointing at the semconv registry concept is the well-posed alignment. The richer correspondences the asymmetry would call for are recorded HERE AS PROJECTION DOCTRINE / intended shape, NOT as generated artifacts: (1) SSSOM term\u2194term for the 1:1 cases (below) \u2014 the layer this file ships; (2) EDOAL structural correspondences where no single term matches \u2014 'gmeow:AgentSession \u2261 an OTel trace whose spans carry gen_ai.*' is a class-expression correspondence, not a term row; (3) FnO value transforms \u2014 gmeow:duringInterval \u2192 span start/end (epoch-nanos), gmeow:samplingTemperature \u2192 gen_ai.request.temperature; (4) CONSTRUCT that would materialize the target view AND the inverse ingest lift. Layers 2\u20134 describe the alignment's intended shape as design characterization; only layer 1 is materialized. DIRECTIONALITY (the Galois-connection shape): projection GMEOW \u2192 OTel is a SoundUnderApproximation \u2014 every emitted span is faithful, but the endurant/epistemic structure (the DigitalSubject and its tenure, InhabitationTenure/Configuration, IdentityContinuityAssessment, ControlAssessment, InhabitationClaim/standpoints, TransferManifest and migration boundaries) is DROPPED, and the ledger says so; ingest OTel \u2192 GMEOW is ENRICHING (subsume-and-extend) \u2014 a trace lifts to a gmeow:RuntimeExecution with its gmeow:ModelInvocation / gmeow:ToolCall sub-events, and GMEOW ADDS the subject, tenure, and attributed provenance the trace could not express, the super-ontology earning its name. ML-METADATA (the LLM-ops hub): gmeow:ModelArtifact / gmeow:ModelDeployment / gmeow:RuntimeExecution align to ML-Schema (mls:Model / mls:Implementation / mls:Run) as SSSOM term rows (below), with the intended shape extending by the same projection doctrine to Model Cards, Croissant, SPDX-AI, and MLflow runs \u2014 making the model-serving slice a hub for LLM-ops metadata (under-approximation, L/I). Only the shipped term rows are materialized; the broader-target correspondences are recorded here as doctrine. LOSS LEDGER: the OTel and ML rows are skos:relatedMatch or closeMatch (cross-category or broader-target, lossy); the flagship projection is honestly a SoundUnderApproximation, not 'supported' \u2014 what a target cannot hold is recorded, never silently dropped (Principles 4, 7)."

# # INHERITED BY REFERENCE (not re-authored here): PROV-O — gmeow:RuntimeExecution / gmeow:AgentSession ⊑ gmeow:Activity ↔ prov:Activity (owned by the provenance slice); gmeow:ModelArtifact ⊑ gmeow:InformationObject ↔ the kernel entity alignment. the OTel EDOAL/FnO structural-and-value correspondences are recorded above as projection doctrine, not materialized artifacts: this file emits SSSOM term rows only, because the term row at concept grain is the well-posed projection for the OTel gen_ai.* span-attribute-key targets (no RDF view exists for a lawful logic:Correspondence lens to project into).

# # OWNED ELSEWHERE (align once): the OTel gen_ai.* rows for gmeow:ModelInvocation (an LLM chat span), gmeow:ToolCall (a tool span), gmeow:usedTool (gen_ai.tool.name), and gmeow:samplingTemperature / samplingMaxTokens (gen_ai.request.*) belong to the ai and agentic slices that mint those terms — referenced from model-serving transitively, never re-aligned here.

column6: the session aggregate ↔ an OTel trace whose spans carry gen_ai.* (gen_ai.conversation.id); a structural (EDOAL) correspondence surfaced as a loose term row — the endurant subject/tenure the session carries has no OTel counterpart

the content-digested served model ↔ mls:Model, ML-Schema's trained-model artifact; a close but not exact match — mls:Model is the learned model, gmeow:ModelArtifact adds the distribution/versioning framing aligned by reference to the software slice
the served model artifact's identity ↔ gen_ai.request.model / gen_ai.response.model; OTel carries the model name as a span attribute, dropping the content-digested artifact identity

the served, callable realization ↔ mls:Implementation, ML-Schema's executable implementation of an algorithm; relatedMatch only — a gmeow:ModelDeployment additionally binds a service identity, host, endpoint, and serving interval

the served, callable realization's provider/service ↔ gen_ai.system (e.g. anthropic); OTel records the serving provider as a flat attribute, dropping the deployment's artifact·host·endpoint·interval binding structure

a particular running of a deployment ↔ mls:Run, ML-Schema's execution of an implementation on data; relatedMatch — mls:Run is training/evaluation-centred, gmeow:RuntimeExecution is a serving occurrent within which gmeow:ModelInvocation events occur

the occurrent running of a deployment ↔ an OTel agent root span (gen_ai.agent.id / .name, gen_ai.operation.name = create_agent/invoke_agent); the span captures the process, not the deployment relator it runs
